summary: Mayfair Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a November 2, 2026 news release announcing that its 100%-owned Fenn-Gib Gold Project in the Timmins region of Northern Ontario was designated under Ontario's 'One Project, One Process' permitting framework. The designation provides a single provincial point of contact, targets roughly 50% reduction in government review times, and could support a construction decision as early as 2028 and production by 2030. No transaction, shareholder, capital-structure or board-change event is disclosed. Watch permitting milestones and Indigenous consultation progress rather than deal terms.
